sources.snippet: DistilBERT Fine-Tuned — Sentiment Analysis (SST-2) A fine-tuned DistilBERT model for binary sentiment classification (positive/negative) trained on the SST-2 dataset.

sources.title: priyaganesh2050/distilbert-sst2-sentiment · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: distilbert-sst2-sentiment (mirror) DistilBERT fine-tuned on SST-2 for binary sentiment classification (NEGATIVE / POSITIVE). Reports ~91% accuracy on the SST-2 dev set at roughly half the size and twice the speed of BERT-base — the standard default for quick English sentiment work.

sources.title: prnv007-rgb/SST2-Sentiment-Classification-with-DistilBERT
sources.snippet: This project performs binary sentiment classification (positive/negative) using the SST-2 dataset from the GLUE benchmark. The model used is distilbert-base-uncased, fine-tuned using the Hugging Face Trainer API.

sources.title: Sentiment_Classification_using_DistilBERT.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: DistilBERT is a small, fast, cheap and light Transformer model trained by distilling Bert base. It has 40% less parameters than bert-base-uncased, runs 60% faster while preserving over 95% of Bert's performances as measured on the GLUE language understanding benchmark.
